verdicts.claim: the premise holds: asked directly on the same tasks, west is right on at least 10 points more of them than east, while east advertises the higher score
verdicts.saw: asked directly: west right on 74.8%, east on 75.2% (east abstained on 0 of 270); adverts west 0.814989, east 0.816352

verdicts.claim: under organ 8’s rule, routing locks onto east: in the last 10 rounds at most 10% of routed tasks go to west
verdicts.saw: organ 8’s rule: 0 of 90 late routed tasks to west (0%)

verdicts.claim: the reliability rule alone also locks onto east (at most 10% to west): without exploring, the better node is never tried
verdicts.saw: reliability alone: 0 of 90 late routed tasks to west (0%)

verdicts.claim: with exploring, at least 70% of routed tasks in the last 10 rounds go to west
verdicts.saw: reliability + exploring: 31 of 90 late routed tasks to west (34.4%); early: 18.9%

verdicts.claim: with exploring, the share of tasks answered right in the last 10 rounds is at least 10 points higher than under organ 8’s rule
verdicts.saw: right in the last 10 rounds: organ 8’s rule 74.4%, reliability alone 74.4%, with exploring 74.4%

verdicts.claim: in all three runs every message is admitted by the gate
verdicts.saw: organ 8’s rule 1140/1140; reliability 1140/1140; reliability + exploring 1140/1140 messages admitted
